Name: Game Port
Description: UDP gameplay and TCP status queries; written to server.serverPort in server_config.toml.

Name: Steam Query Port
Description: Steam query/status UDP port; written to authentication.steamGameServerQueryPort.

Name: TCP Console Port
Description: Reserved for the optional TCP admin console. Disabled and loopback-only by default.

Name: Web Panel Port
Description: Reserved for the optional local web panel. Disabled and loopback-only by default.
